title: Napoleonic Skeletons
body:
### Minecraft skeletons are boring. So, I turned them into an army! ![An image of what the texture pack does](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab74371dbd34b1913ff5e57c0e5b9bdb66f0c451_0.webp) Napoleonic Skeletons does exactly what you expect it to do, it turns the skeletons, well, Napoleonic. And, while they're not perfectly historically accurate, most people would probably prefer them over the bland, original Minecraft skeletons, at least for a bit. ### Common Questions and Answers:
Q: Does the hitbox of the skeleton get larger because of the changed shape?
A: nope. the hitbox, even though the actual skeleton is bigger, is the exact same as the old one.
Q: Do the hat and boots have collision enabled?
A: nope. you can click through the hat, place blocks through the hat, punch through the hat, and shoot through the hat. Same for the boots. they're just purely visual, no strings attached. Just don't attempt to hit the skeleton through the hat, it won't work.
Q: Will the skeleton suffocate if the hat is in a block?
A: nope. the skeleton will behave like nothing happened, the hat is purely visual and does not have collision or a hitbox.
Q: If the skeleton has armor, will the new texture and shape hold?
A: no, and becuase of that, the armor will render on top of the vanilla skin. This is a limitation of EMF, and as such, there isn't really a workaround, you kinda just have to deal with it.
